Their needs always came first.|Silood leads Onaconda Farr's funeral|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
'''Silood''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] and a confidant to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Silood was a longtime aide to Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], taking care of his schedule and offering advice when Farr wanted a word with his old friend.<ref name="TCWCE" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he was present on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during Farr's [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|dealings]] with [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> When Farr was [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]], Silood delivered the eulogy at Farr's [[Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends|funeral]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and accompanied the body back to Rodia.<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SiloodFarrEulogy-SM.png|thumb|left|200px|Silood presides over the funeral of Senator Farr]]
Silood was portrayed in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]] by [[Tom Kenny]],<ref name=":0" /> who also voiced Nute Gunray and police inspector [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] in the show.

Silood, or at least his character model, was first seen in [[Ziro's Palace]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|feature film]] that debuted the series on [[August 15]], [[2008]]. He was sitting next to the character model used for [[Pune Zignat]]. It would not be impossible for Silood to be present at this [[Coruscant]] establishment at the time, as [[Onaconda Farr]] was also in the area. He appears in another scene set in [[Palpatine's office]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> His character model was also used for [[Taquito/Legends|Taquito]] in "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]".<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>
